# moddotplot-rs v0.6.0

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.6.0 is a cleanup and export-usability release. It remains a functional preview;
additional usability work will precede v1.0.0.

## Simpler production surface

Sparse correction has been removed from the browser protocol, controls, Wasm API,
resource model, and ordinary web build. Candidate estimators, the rejected fused
register projection, sparse policy, and sparse kernels now live together under the
non-default Rust `validation` module.

Export behavior is owned by a dedicated controller/composition path rather than the
main UI orchestrator, and tile-selection policy has moved out of the compute worker.

## Current-view Save As export

**Export data** now opens a Save As dialog. BEDPE is the default, with CSV available
for complete fixed-point renderer channels. Both formats include only cells
intersecting the active viewport and retain method and configuration provenance.

**Export image** also opens a Save As dialog and defaults to PNG. PNG, SVG, and PDF all
include the visible heatmap, coordinate axes, sequence labels, and computed or imported
tracks. SVG/PDF embed the heatmap as a raster image while keeping axes, labels, track
geometry, and track labels vectorized.

See the [validation record](v0.6.0/VALIDATION.md) for release qualification.
